name: packaging-config
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the framework adopts a different distribution channel than a self-hosted Claude Code plugin marketplace, or when later slices fold this into a full configure/run UX feature.
spec_change_reason: Cut release v0.38.0 (minor, default-config route CONTENT change — DROP REVIEW from the shipped default route): bump _PLUGIN_VERSION 0.37.0 -> 0.38.0 and regenerate the committed plugin tree so the shipped default-config/route.json drops the advisory REVIEW state — states no longer lists REVIEW, VERIFY OK routes directly to GATE, and the REVIEW OK->GATE + REVIEW EMPTY->PERSIST edges are removed (a REVIEW-in-route loop with work_own_filings on self-feeds and does not converge; GATE reads verdicts/gate_results and INTEGRATE reads only verdicts, so VERIFY->GATE is data-ready with no review_findings). The default-config/adapter-map.json is UNCHANGED — it still MAPS the REVIEW port (unused) so a project route.json override can re-add REVIEW. No _LIBS change (lib digest byte-identical), no config.json change, no shipped-agent change. The version-assertion test advanced to 0.38.0, the pipeline-wiring test updated to assert VERIFY OK->GATE with no REVIEW state/edges, the seed-assets test updated (REVIEW dropped from route, still mapped in adapter-map), a committed-tree e2e added asserting the REVIEW-less route validates + resolves through the plugin's own lib/, test/release_lib_baseline.json re-anchored (version -> 0.38.0, lib_digest unchanged), and the housekeep doc baseline re-anchored to the grown spec (521 -> 535) so the drift, #355 monotonicity, and doc-size guards stay green.
spec_no_change_reason: Spec already carries the Plugin minor v0.38.0 section (committed 0bdcd10); this cycle enacts the drop-REVIEW default-config/route.json change, version bump, tree regen, and test/baseline re-anchor only.
